name: numerical_audit_evidence
command: import json,pathlib; r=json.loads(pathlib.Path('results/phase3/numerical_audit.json').read_text()); print(json.dumps({'status':r['status'],'audited_sample_count':r['audited_sample_count'],'failed_sample_count':r['failed_sample_count'],'sinkhorn_iterations':r['sinkhorn_iterations']},indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if r['status']=='PASS' and r['failed_sample_count']==0 else 1)
